title: Evolution by Emergence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v22.0 retains the v21 universal retained-organization/accessibility and cumulative-reproduction core and closes the intelligent-system specialization with audited Anchor-Safety, reflexive self-model, shared-layer, and correction-preserving transition results. Formal verification establishes implications under explicit premises; empirical, causal, political and normative interpretations remain open. The original repository material is dual-licensed under CC BY 4.0 OR Apache-2.0 as documented in DUAL-LICENSING.md; CC BY 4.0 is supplied here as the single Zenodo archival metadata value because the GitHub-Zenodo metadata path accepts one license value.
